324	"Korat ruach" is when you haven't yet entered Gan Eden, you only catch a little

326	inside. In Jerusalem there is the Angel bakery. Whoever walks

328	How pleasant it is there. That is called "korat ruach." Better one hour

330	What is the logic? At first glance it sounds a bit exaggerated. What is
331	the logic? The logic is simple: matter, as is known, is
332	a kind of imagination. We see matter as something
333	real because that is what we perceive with our eyes. But
334	in truth, matter is a kind of imagination.
335	Even science is beginning to understand this. We know
336	that all matter is made of atoms, tiny particles
337	all packed tightly one next
338	to the other. On the tip of a pin, how many atoms are there at the finest
339	point? How many atoms are there? You would have to write the number
340	three, and then 15 zeros. That is the number of atoms
341	on the tip of a pin. And what is each atom made of?
342	An inner nucleus, with electrons spinning around it
343	at speed, and they create an illusion of a shell. Like
344	a fan: it has blades, but when it spins
345	fast you see a disc. The disc is an illusion. It
346	looks like a solid atom, but it is not solid, it is only
347	the speed. Electrons move at speed
348	and create the illusion of a shell, and when there are billions
349	upon billions of them packed together, we see
350	matter. Physicists claim: what would happen if
351	the electrons stopped
352	their motion? What would happen? The entire universe
353	would disappear. They claim that the true matter of the whole planet
354	Earth could fit in a matchbox. That is the real matter
355	that exists; all the rest is imagination. It is a kind
356	of... Since matter is imagination, say the masters of
357	the Secret, the pleasures we enjoy are also a kind of
358	imagination. In the material world, when a person enjoys, it is a kind of
359	imagination, but he enjoys because it suits matter.
